summary: Thumbor is a smart imaging service that handles on-demand image cropping, resizing, filter application, and optimisation. It allows you to process and serve image transformations dynamically rather than storing multiple static variants on disk.
goodFor: It is a good fit if you run a media-heavy platform and need to offload image processing and thumbnail generation from your primary application servers.
watchOut: High volumes of uncached requests can heavily strain CPU and memory resources, requiring careful tuning and upstream caching strategies to maintain acceptable performance.
deployNotes: As a Python application packaged for Docker, you will typically deploy it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and place a caching layer like Varnish or Nginx in front of it to handle repeated image requests efficiently.
